content.text: The changed file (`conversationContent.tsx`) contains only static, hardcoded string constants used as invented demo content for a fake terminal conversation display. There is no attacker-influenceable input, no dynamic string construction, and the consumer files (`TerminalConversation.tsx`, `useStreamingReveal.ts`) do not use `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, `innerHTML`, `eval`, or any other code-execution/injection sink. The diff itself only edits the literal text of demo strings (component names, prose, and a fake Figma URL) — none of which reach a security-relevant sink.
